name: Caisse regionale de Credit Agricole Mutuel Atlantique Vendee
summary: Caisse régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Atlantique Vendée provides banking products and services in France. It offers payment and account management services; mortgages and consumer credit products; and savings products, financial investments, and life and property insurance products, as well as retirement products. The company serves individuals, businesses, professionals, farmers, and associations. Caisse régionale de Crédit Agricole Mutuel Atlantique Vendée is headquartered in Nantes, France.
